parse_args_cli: parse CLI arguments for the autoresearch tool including workdir, agent, pipeline script, and platform options
split_workdir_and_request: split parsed CLI args into a workdir path and a free-form user request string
build_engine_command: build the engine command list with agent, platform, pipeline script, source dir, and launch command flags
build_supervisor_context: build a supervisor context string listing missing required first-run configuration inputs for the engine
build_supervisor_prompt: build the supervisor system prompt that loads the autoresearch category and configuration details
